name: Seedbed Matron
senses: blindsight 60 ft. (blind beyond this radius), tremorsense 60 ft.; Passive Perception 11

Traits.name: Husked Inheritance
Traits.text: When a creature dies within 10 feet of the matron, the matron's spores sink into the corpse and hollow it, raising it as a puppet that obeys the matron's will; the puppet remains animate until the end of the matron's next turn, then collapses into inert husk. The matron cannot do this to a creature that has already been husked.
Traits.clause: takes over the bodies of the things she kills

Traits.name: Seed-Spore Cloud
Traits.text: *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 18, any creature that starts its turn in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the matron. *Failure:* The target has the Poisoned condition until the start of its next turn. *Success:* The target is immune to this creature's aura for 24 hours.

Traits.name: Aura of Authority
Traits.text: While in a 10-foot Emanation originating from the matron, the matron and its allies have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws, provided the matron doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The matron makes three attacks, using Root-Filament or Husk Lash in any combination.

Actions.name: Root-Filament
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. 15 (2d8 + 6) Bludgeoning damage plus 11 (2d10) Poison damage.

Actions.name: Husk Lash
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +10, reach 5 ft. 28 (5d8 + 6) Slashing damage.

Bonus Actions.name: Choking Sporebank (2/Day)
Bonus Actions.text: The matron fills a 15-foot-radius Sphere centered on a point it can see within 60 feet. The area is Lightly Obscured and Difficult Terrain until the start of the matron's next turn.

lore: A fruiting fungus that grew a mind in the hollow of a battlefield, she means to plant herself in a corpse-rich place and turn every living thing around her into soil for that day.

unplaced.text: Husked puppets lurch toward the nearest living thing with the matron's borrowed purpose.
